description: MainActivity.java is the primary activity class for an Android app demonstrating runtime permissions handling. It manages permission requests for camera and contacts, showing appropriate fragments when permissions are granted, and provides UI feedback via Snackbars. It also includes logging setup and menu controls.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for an Android app demonstrating runtime permission handling, fragment management, and logging.

methods.name: showCamera
methods.description: Handles click event to initiate camera permission check and show camera preview if granted.

methods.name: requestCameraPermission
methods.description: Requests camera permission, showing rationale Snackbar if needed.

methods.name: showContacts
methods.description: Handles click event to check contact permissions and display contacts fragment if permitted.

methods.name: requestContactsPermissions
methods.description: Requests contact permissions with rationale if needed.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles result of permission requests, providing user feedback via Snackbars.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, adds default fragment, and sets up logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Configure logging chain for app diagnostics.
